function: Joint dual-functional waveform and RIS phase-shift design for ISAC, trading MUI energy against waveform discrepancy, by a deep-unfolded ADMM network (pp. 3-4, 6).
system: RIS-aided ISAC: BS with 10 antennas, 2 single-antenna users, reflecting RIS with 10 elements, no direct link; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 9).
method: Deep unfolding network ADMM-NET with learnable matrix-inverse approximations, trained unsupervised with Adam; black-box fully connected NN trained supervised and unsupervised as benchmark (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Synthetic Gaussian channels with small-scale fading only, BPSK symbols; 200 training samples, results averaged over 500 channel realizations (p. 9, Table II).
test_conditions: Training: 200 Gaussian channel samples at default sizes. Testing: 500 independent realizations, sweeping SNR, rho, RIS size M, antenna number Nt; no model transfer reported (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: the authors' own ADMM iterative algorithm. Learned: black-box fully connected NN, supervised (SL) and unsupervised (USL), 4 layers of 2048 neurons (p. 9).
metrics: Weighted sum of MUI energy and waveform discrepancy (percent of ADMM), BER, average achievable rate, beampattern, CPU training and testing time (pp. 10-11).
complexity: Big-O order O(In(L^2.37 Nt^2.37 + ...)) for In layers, parameter count, CPU testing time in seconds (Table V) (pp. 8, 11).
q1_support: p. 9: "we consider that all the channels are Gaussian". Missing: no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model and no measured data; the paper says it considers only small-scale fading.
q2_support: p. 9: "averaged over 500 independent channel realizations". Missing: no test of a trained model with another array size, RIS size, channel distribution or band; the sweeps over M, Nt and SNR (pp. 10-11) are not reported as transfer of one trained model.
q3_support: p. 9: "The traditional iterative algorithm and black-box NN are taken into consideration for performance comparison"; ADMM is the non-learned method, SL and USL are the fully connected NNs, compared on WSMEWD, BER and rate (Table IV, Figs. 7 and 9).
q4_support: p. 8: "According to [43], the computational complexity of ADMM-NET is" O(In(L^2.37 Nt^2.37 + L^2 K Nt + M^2.37 + M^2 K L + L^2 Nt M)); the parameter count is also given, and CPU running times are in Table V (p. 11).
q5_support: p. 9: "we consider that all the channels are Gaussian". Missing: the data are synthetic Gaussian channels; no code or data link, public dataset or measured data appears in pp. 1-13.
notes: Area 5: the learned network designs the ISAC waveform and the RIS phase shifts together, and area 5 wins over area 3. Deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned (p. 6). The conclusion claims generalization capability (p. 12) but no experiment tests a trained model in a new condition; Table IV only varies the training-set size. Confirm q3: the non-learned baseline is the authors' own ADMM algorithm and the learned baselines are generic fully connected NNs built by the authors, with no earlier published learned ISAC method. Tables I to V and Figs. 4 to 10 were checked on the page images.
